# Font Awesome 7 Free (Solid)

`FontAwesome7-Free-Solid-900.otf` is the Solid style of Font Awesome Free 7, taken unchanged from
the previous engine's `Application/` folder. It is the editor's icon font (D-96): the editor merges
it into the UI font at start-up so icon glyphs (U+F000..U+F8FF) sit next to the text glyphs.

License: the font file is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, and the icon designs under
CC BY 4.0. Both permit redistribution with attribution. See <https://fontawesome.com/license/free>.
Attribution: "Font Awesome Free by @fontawesome - https://fontawesome.com".

The glyphs the editor uses are listed in `Include/JBro/Editor/EditorIcons.h`; nothing else of the
font is referenced.
